name: Alibaba Cloud Hologres
summary: Run queries and load Parquet partitions into Hologres over its PostgreSQL protocol. Loads are idempotent by partition and revision (ADR 0012).

auth.label: AccessKey pair as user name and password

settings.name: endpoint
settings.label: Instance endpoint
settings.help: The domain name of the instance, from the Hologres console, without the port.

settings.name: port
settings.label: Port
settings.help: Shown with the endpoint in the Hologres console.

egress.note: Each instance has its own port in the console. 80 is listed here as the value commonly shown; set the port setting to the one your instance uses.

operators.summary: Run a SQL query and keep the result as Parquet.
Copy Parquet rows into a table with COPY FROM STDIN, once per partition and revision.

notes: Hologres can also read MaxCompute and OSS data through foreign tables; stage in OSS (see that connector) if you prefer that route. Ogun does not create the table.
